title: Amadeus accounts and the office pool
caption: Mirrors admin-amadeus-pool.e2e.ts. The stub (pnpm stub:amadeus, http://127.0.0.1:4900) stands in for Amadeus outside production.

steps.title: Set up an environment's account
steps.body: **Set up the Live account**: Name, Amadeus host, Client id, Client secret → **Save and verify** (asks for a TOTP code when your last code is older than 15 min).
steps.expect: 'The Live account is saved.', status Not verified, then Active within ~20 s (page refreshes every 5 s); client id shows only its last 4; secret 'Stored encrypted, never shown'; 'Only 0 offices are available in Live.' warning.

steps.title: Add offices in bulk
steps.body: In **Add offices** pick the account, paste one 9-character id per line (lower case is fine, repeat one), optional notes → **Add offices**.
steps.expect: '3 offices were added:' with the Added offices and the Skipped ids lists; new rows Available.

steps.title: Assign to a waiting OTA
steps.body: **Assign office <id>** → type the OTA key (or tenant id) → **Assign office**.
steps.expect: 'Office <id> is assigned to <key>.' with connection Active; the OTA's Connections tab card shows the office; the owner's portal Amadeus page shows it.

steps.title: Retire and edit notes
steps.body: **Retire office <id>** with a reason; **Edit notes** on any office.
steps.expect: Retired offices offer no Assign/Retire; notes use If-Match (stale → 412 with reload link).

steps.title: Pool levels
steps.body: Add 3 live offices, then look at the accounts page and the dashboard.
steps.expect: '3 Available' link per environment; the low-pool warning (below 3) disappears.
